argument:
The bear correctly notes that high quality alone cannot authenticate a valuation discount. But stronger official revenue, operating-income and adjusted-EPS results plus modest measured leverage are concrete evidence that the company has capacity to sustain investment while already expanding its business.

Lower FCF and slipped gross margin warrant monitoring rather than automatic extrapolation into permanent impairment. I concede near-term averages and MACD are negative, so immediate timing is weaker than long-term quality. A patient, staged entry after stabilization preserves the bullish thesis without assuming launches already generated incremental profits or investment returns are proved.
rebuttal_to_previous: Concede timing and valuation gaps; delivered earnings growth and leverage capacity distinguish current investment pressure from proved structural deterioration.
